Lucknow Fire Kills 12, Officials Suspended Amid Safety Probe

A fire in a multi-story building in Lucknow has resulted in the deaths of at least 12 individuals, including an engaged couple. Authorities have initiated an investigation into the incident, citing illegal commercial use and inadequate safety measures like a single entry/exit point. In response, four officials have been suspended and four people arrested, while a demolition notice has been issued for the building.
